facts.fact: DHIS2 has been used by Togo's Ministry of Health since 2016 as the country's HMIS, its main data collection and aggregation tool and national repository for health data, owned and maintained by the ministry with HISP WCA support (DHIS2 profile, updated July 2026).
The profile says Togo also uses DHIS2 for infectious disease surveillance, alongside its HMIS role.
